rationale: The census ADD_OWNER action is already satisfied: production and evaluated seed each contain one active ArcLight Capital Partners ownership period, and ArcLight Capital is the same manager. Adding another owner would duplicate the manager. Correct that existing period in place because current primary evidence identifies Infinigen as wholly owned by an ArcLight-managed fund and ArcLight identifies Infinigen as a current Fund VII portfolio company. Preserve 2021 as the year of investment, retain CLOSED_ACTIVE status, and record no pending transaction because no Infinigen-specific sale or exit was found through August 13, 2026.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Count the Infinigen Renewables platform once. Oriana Energy, Horizon Energy, YFN Yabucoa Solar, Infinigen Asset Management, Infinigen O&M and other project entities are subsidiaries or assets beneath the platform and are not separate PortCos.

ownershipResolution.fund: ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P.
ownershipResolution.helioBoundary: Helios Alternative Energy reports an undisclosed minority interest in the Oriana and Horizon operating-asset portfolio. That project-level participation is not evidence that Helios owns the Infinigen Renewables platform, so no platform owner row is added.

acquisitionExitCheck.acquisitionSearch: Sonnedix announced the sale of its Puerto Rico solar operations to Infinigen and ArcLight on November 11, 2021. ArcLight announced on December 16, 2021 that the platform had launched with a $400 million commitment and had completed the initial acquisition of the 73.2 MW Oriana and Horizon portfolio.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentStatusSearch: ArcLight's current investments page lists Infinigen as Current, and its portfolio-services page identifies it as ArcLight Fund VII's portfolio company. Infinigen's current site says it is backed by ArcLight, and an April 2024 company release describes it as wholly owned by an ArcLight-managed fund.
acquisitionExitCheck.exitSearch: No Infinigen-specific sale, divestiture, pending buyer or ArcLight Fund VII exit was identified through August 13, 2026. DigitalBridge's May 2026 agreement to acquire ArcLight remains conditional and is a manager-level transaction, not a transfer of Infinigen or Fund VII's stake.
